# OpenPay Pro Wallet

> Self-custody Web3 wallet for the OpenPay ecosystem: hold OUSD and Pi, swap tokens, mint NFTs, send payments, and track every transaction on a public ledger.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/authpi): Sign in with Pi Network, OpenPay, Phantom, MetaMask, or Telegram.
- [Transfer Pi guide](/guides/transfer-pi): How to transfer Pi Network assets into OpenPay Pro.
- [FAQ](/docs/faq): Wallets, send/receive, currencies, security, and integrations.
- [OpenPay integration docs](/docs/openpay): Connect with OpenPay (OAuth) and OpenPay Balance payments.
- [Claim Test Pi](/testnet-reward): Pi Testnet reward claim page.

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of OpenPay Pro.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How data is collected and protected.
- [Regulatory status](/regulatory): Disclosures on providers and price feeds.
